name: Drip E-Commerce CRM
description: Built specifically for direct-to-consumer e-commerce: abandoned cart triggers, win-back flows, and VIP rewards.
fullDescription: Drip is tailored from the ground up for DTC e-commerce merchants. By capturing comprehensive behavioral signals across your online storefront, Drip empowers brands to craft segmented email and SMS campaigns that drive higher repeat purchase rates and customer lifetime value.
features: DTC-specific revenue analytics and customer lifetime value cohorts
Point-and-click email builder with dynamic live product block imports
Automated discount code generation integrated directly with Shopify checkout
Pre-made workflows for post-purchase upsells, replenishment, and VIP tiers
Advanced behavioral segment triggers based on viewed products and cart items
